modules.title: 一次权限变更怎样留下可追查的证据
审计日志要回答哪些问题

items.title: 先看到发生了什么
items.text: 当管理员改动权限后，只有“当前权限变了”还不够。记录要把操作者、时间、目标对象、动作和成功或拒绝结果关联起来，团队才能还原这次安全相关操作。

items.title: 让追查结果回到权限流程
items.text: 如果成员突然失去结算权限，先按账号、角色和时间筛选记录，再核对请求是否成功以及当时的身份来源。确认原因后修正权限，并用一条新的可查记录证明修正发生了；没有记录或记录不可访问，就无法可靠还原过程。

items.title: 第二个场景：病历更正
items.text: 病历内容被更正时，审计日志应关联操作者、时间、目标病历、修改动作和结果，便于还原谁做了哪次变更；无关的敏感正文不应整段写入日志。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 审计日志记录谁对什么做了什么，重点是责任追踪；报错日志解释程序哪里失败；监控持续观察错误率、延迟等健康信号。审计日志也不是“什么都记”：请求正文可能包含密码、令牌或个人信息，应按用途控制记录字段、保留时间和访问权限。

lessonPractice.title: 有人把财务组成员移出了结算权限。哪条证据最适合先用来追查？

options.label: 查找包含操作者、时间、目标权限、动作和结果的审计记录
options.feedback: 对。审计记录把一次安全相关操作的关键事实放在同一条可追查证据里。

options.label: 只搜索服务端报错日志，看到没有报错就认定没有权限变更
options.feedback: 权限修改可能完全成功，不一定产生报错；报错日志也通常不会回答是谁主动执行了变更。

options.label: 查看当天请求量曲线，按曲线峰值推断是哪位管理员操作的
options.feedback: 请求量只能显示数量变化，不能关联具体操作者、目标权限和动作结果。

en.title: Someone removed a finance-team member's checkout permission. Which evidence should you use first?

options.label: Find an audit record with the actor, time, target permission, action, and result
options.feedback: Correct. An audit record puts the key facts of a security-relevant action into one traceable piece of evidence.

options.label: Search only server error logs; no error means no permission changed
options.feedback: A permission change can succeed without an error, and an error log usually does not identify who intentionally made the change.

options.label: Use the day's request-volume chart to infer which administrator acted from the peak
options.feedback: Request volume shows counts, not the actor, target permission, action, or result.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为管理员权限变更补上审计日志，至少记录操作者、时间、目标账号或角色、变更动作和成功/拒绝结果。不要把密码或不必要的敏感内容写入日志。改完后用一次成功和一次被拒绝的变更验证记录能被查到，并说明谁可以访问这些记录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add audit logging for administrator permission changes. Record at least the actor, time, target account or role, action, and success or denial result. Do not write passwords or unnecessary sensitive content to the log. Verify one successful and one denied change, show that both records are searchable, and state who can access them.

learning.assumes: You know an administrator's action can change an account, permission, or resource state.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a record is sufficient to investigate a permission change and distinguish audit logs from errors and monitoring.

modules.title: How one permission change leaves traceable evidence
Which questions an audit log should answer

items.title: Make the action visible
items.text: Knowing only that the current permission changed is not enough. Connect the actor, time, target, action, and success or denial result so the team can reconstruct the security-relevant operation.

items.title: Return investigation to the permission flow
items.text: If a member suddenly loses checkout access, filter records by account, role, and time, then check whether the request succeeded and which identity source was involved. Fix the cause and verify a new searchable record; without accessible records, the sequence cannot be reconstructed reliably.

items.title: A second scenario: correcting a medical record
items.text: When a medical record is corrected, the audit log should connect the actor, time, target record, change, and result so the team can reconstruct who changed what. Unrelated sensitive content should not be copied into the log in full.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: An audit log tracks who did what to which object for accountability; an error log explains where a program failed; monitoring observes health signals such as error rate and latency. Auditing is not logging everything: request bodies may contain passwords, tokens, or personal data, so fields, retention, and access must be controlled.
